description: Duplicate an event (tickets, payment options, refund policy, tax settings) into a new event with a new ID, optionally with a new name and dates. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/copy/.

end_date.description: End of the new event, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

start_date.description: Start of the new event, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

timezone.description: Olson timezone for the new event.

name: eventbrite_copy_event
title: Copy an event
